meta.title: Deletion
meta.description: There is nothing in this world that will indulge an endless number of attempts.

units.rawText: Helios Sector, at the core of the Arche Pyr.
units.displayText: Helios Sector, at the core of the Arche Pyr.

spans.text: Helios Sector, at the core of the Arche Pyr.

units.rawText: [(〃'▽'〃) This way, this way. The core of the Arche Pyr is this way.]
units.displayText: [(〃'▽'〃) This way, this way. The core of the Arche Pyr is this way.]

spans.text: [(〃'▽'〃) This way, this way. The core of the Arche Pyr is this way.]

units.rawText: Are these the primitive robots you were talking about? They look really cute!
units.displayText: Are these the primitive robots you were talking about? They look really cute!

spans.text: Are these the primitive robots you were talking about? They look really cute!

units.rawText: [(〃＞皿＜) Please do not hug the robot. Please do not hug the robot. This robot may be small, but it values its cleanliness.]
units.displayText: [(〃＞皿＜) Please do not hug the robot. Please do not hug the robot. This robot may be small, but it values its cleanliness.]

spans.text: [(〃＞皿＜) Please do not hug the robot. Please do not hug the robot. This robot may be small, but it values its cleanliness.]

units.rawText: ...Quit playing around, Sol.
units.displayText: ...Quit playing around, Sol.

spans.text: ...Quit playing around, Sol.

units.rawText: Professor, do you think what that Sanctifier Eucharist said was true?
units.displayText: Professor, do you think what that Sanctifier Eucharist said was true?

spans.text: Professor, do you think what that Sanctifier Eucharist said was true?

units.rawText: She had no reason to lie to us. If she really meant us ill, she could have just attacked us directly.
units.displayText: She had no reason to lie to us. If she really meant us ill, she could have just attacked us directly.

spans.text: She had no reason to lie to us. If she really meant us ill, she could have just attacked us directly.

units.rawText: [(oﾟ▽ﾟ)o Welcome to the core of the Arche Pyr. This is the most highly-classified area in the Helios Sector.]
units.displayText: [(oﾟ▽ﾟ)o Welcome to the core of the Arche Pyr. This is the most highly-classified area in the Helios Sector.]

spans.text: [(oﾟ▽ﾟ)o Welcome to the core of the Arche Pyr. This is the most highly-classified area in the Helios Sector.]

units.rawText: [ヾ(ﾟ∀ﾟゞ) Here you will see the most cutting-edge creations of the energy industry!]
units.displayText: [ヾ(ﾟ∀ﾟゞ) Here you will see the most cutting-edge creations of the energy industry!]

spans.text: [ヾ(ﾟ∀ﾟゞ) Here you will see the most cutting-edge creations of the energy industry!]

units.rawText: ...Why does this feel so weird to me?
units.displayText: ...Why does this feel so weird to me?

spans.text: ...Why does this feel so weird to me?

units.rawText: What's wrong, Persicaria?
units.displayText: What's wrong, Persicaria?

spans.text: What's wrong, Persicaria?

units.rawText: Although we were planning to help them solve the problem in the first place, everything's going too smoothly.
units.displayText: Although we were planning to help them solve the problem in the first place, everything's going too smoothly.

spans.text: Although we were planning to help them solve the problem in the first place, everything's going too smoothly.

units.rawText: Nobody got in our way and nobody asked us for our intentions. Instead they just welcomed us right in. That makes me feel a little uneasy.
units.displayText: Nobody got in our way and nobody asked us for our intentions. Instead they just welcomed us right in. That makes me feel a little uneasy.

spans.text: Nobody got in our way and nobody asked us for our intentions. Instead they just welcomed us right in. That makes me feel a little uneasy.

units.rawText: Why are you worrying so much? Are you becoming suspicious because everyone keeps thinking of us as bad people?
units.displayText: Why are you worrying so much? Are you becoming suspicious because everyone keeps thinking of us as bad people?

spans.text: Why are you worrying so much? Are you becoming suspicious because everyone keeps thinking of us as bad people?

units.rawText: Maybe they're just being kind... Speaking of which, these statues are really detailed. It's almost as though they were alive.
units.displayText: Maybe they're just being kind... Speaking of which, these statues are really detailed. It's almost as though they were alive.

spans.text: Maybe they're just being kind... Speaking of which, these statues are really detailed. It's almost as though they were alive.

units.rawText: ...You're right. I hope I'm overthinking this.
units.displayText: ...You're right. I hope I'm overthinking this.

spans.text: ...You're right. I hope I'm overthinking this.

units.rawText: [(꒪Д꒪)ノ Boss, boss, we have guests. Come meet them.]
units.displayText: [(꒪Д꒪)ノ Boss, boss, we have guests. Come meet them.]

spans.text: [(꒪Д꒪)ノ Boss, boss, we have guests. Come meet them.]

units.rawText: [Welcome to the Helios Sector. What can I do for you?]
units.displayText: [Welcome to the Helios Sector. What can I do for you?]

spans.text: [Welcome to the Helios Sector. What can I do for you?]

units.rawText: Hello. We are agents from the outside.
units.displayText: Hello. We are agents from the outside.

spans.text: Hello. We are agents from the outside.

units.rawText: [Your origins are not important. What is important is that you repaired Reactor No.1, which has advanced the progress of history forward by a step.]
units.displayText: [Your origins are not important. What is important is that you repaired Reactor No.1, which has advanced the progress of history forward by a step.]

spans.text: [Your origins are not important. What is important is that you repaired Reactor No.1, which has advanced the progress of history forward by a step.]

units.rawText: [Progressing a reset point is a great achievement. I have already recorded your contributions within the log file.]
units.displayText: [Progressing a reset point is a great achievement. I have already recorded your contributions within the log file.]

spans.text: [Progressing a reset point is a great achievement. I have already recorded your contributions within the log file.]

units.rawText: [May I know what you need, oh outstanding contributors?]
units.displayText: [May I know what you need, oh outstanding contributors?]

spans.text: [May I know what you need, oh outstanding contributors?]

units.rawText: ...We wish to leave this place.
units.displayText: ...We wish to leave this place.

spans.text: ...We wish to leave this place.

units.rawText: [Bad Request. Bad Request.]
units.displayText: [Bad Request. Bad Request.]

spans.text: [Bad Request. Bad Request.]

units.rawText: [No agents may leave until the Arche Pyr Project is complete.]
units.displayText: [No agents may leave until the Arche Pyr Project is complete.]

spans.text: [No agents may leave until the Arche Pyr Project is complete.]

units.rawText: What the hell? Are you planning to detain us by force, then?
units.displayText: What the hell? Are you planning to detain us by force, then?

spans.text: What the hell? Are you planning to detain us by force, then?

units.rawText: Calm down, Sol. Let's figure out what exactly is going on in this sector.
units.displayText: Calm down, Sol. Let's figure out what exactly is going on in this sector.

spans.text: Calm down, Sol. Let's figure out what exactly is going on in this sector.

units.rawText: If we can't leave, then what about the resets?
units.displayText: If we can't leave, then what about the resets?

spans.text: If we can't leave, then what about the resets?

units.rawText: [The resets are a unique system established for the sake of the Arche Pyr Project. They allow the entire sector to be rolled back whenever an experiment fails.]
units.displayText: [The resets are a unique system established for the sake of the Arche Pyr Project. They allow the entire sector to be rolled back whenever an experiment fails.]

spans.text: [The resets are a unique system established for the sake of the Arche Pyr Project. They allow the entire sector to be rolled back whenever an experiment fails.]

units.rawText: It's like what Zion said.
units.displayText: It's like what Zion said.

spans.text: It's like what Zion said.

units.rawText: We are simply agents who accidentally entered here. Could you allow us to leave the sector? We are willing to provide help to the Arche Pyr Project in the future.
units.displayText: We are simply agents who accidentally entered here. Could you allow us to leave the sector? We are willing to provide help to the Arche Pyr Project in the future.

spans.text: We are simply agents who accidentally entered here. Could you allow us to leave the sector? We are willing to provide help to the Arche Pyr Project in the future.

units.rawText: [Bad Request. Bad Request.]
units.displayText: [Bad Request. Bad Request.]

spans.text: [Bad Request. Bad Request.]

units.rawText: [No agents may leave until the Arche Pyr Project is complete.]
units.displayText: [No agents may leave until the Arche Pyr Project is complete.]

spans.text: [No agents may leave until the Arche Pyr Project is complete.]

units.rawText: Dammit, does it not understand what we're saying?
units.displayText: Dammit, does it not understand what we're saying?

spans.text: Dammit, does it not understand what we're saying?

units.rawText: We're not here because of the Arche Pyr Project. Please allow us to leave the Helios Sector.
units.displayText: We're not here because of the Arche Pyr Project. Please allow us to leave the Helios Sector.

spans.text: We're not here because of the Arche Pyr Project. Please allow us to leave the Helios Sector.

units.rawText: [Bad Request. Bad Request.]
units.displayText: [Bad Request. Bad Request.]

spans.text: [Bad Request. Bad Request.]

units.rawText: [No agents may leave until the Arche Pyr Project is complete.]
units.displayText: [No agents may leave until the Arche Pyr Project is complete.]

spans.text: [No agents may leave until the Arche Pyr Project is complete.]

units.rawText: We are briefly at a loss for how to deal with a Sector Administrator who mechanically repeats its lines.
units.displayText: We are briefly at a loss for how to deal with a Sector Administrator who mechanically repeats its lines.

spans.text: We are briefly at a loss for how to deal with a Sector Administrator who mechanically repeats its lines.

units.rawText: Is it stupid?
units.displayText: Is it stupid?

spans.text: Is it stupid?

units.rawText: ...I think we may have made a mistake.
units.displayText: ...I think we may have made a mistake.

spans.text: ...I think we may have made a mistake.

units.rawText: Our experiences in Rossum and Cyclopes made us mistakenly assume that the administrators of each sector must be extremely intelligent and free-willed.
units.displayText: Our experiences in Rossum and Cyclopes made us mistakenly assume that the administrators of each sector must be extremely intelligent and free-willed.

spans.text: Our experiences in Rossum and Cyclopes made us mistakenly assume that the administrators of each sector must be extremely intelligent and free-willed.

units.rawText: But this administrator... For some reason, it has very little initiative and we can't communicate with it.
units.displayText: But this administrator... For some reason, it has very little initiative and we can't communicate with it.

spans.text: But this administrator... For some reason, it has very little initiative and we can't communicate with it.

units.rawText: Are we just going to give up like this?
units.displayText: Are we just going to give up like this?

spans.text: Are we just going to give up like this?

units.rawText: Of course not... This might be a little rude, but Sol, help me hold it down.
units.displayText: Of course not... This might be a little rude, but Sol, help me hold it down.

spans.text: Of course not... This might be a little rude, but Sol, help me hold it down.

units.rawText: Sure.
units.displayText: Sure.

spans.text: Sure.

units.rawText: Sol subdues the Sector administrator without much effort. Surprisingly enough, it does not put up much resistance.
units.displayText: Sol subdues the Sector administrator without much effort. Surprisingly enough, it does not put up much resistance.

spans.text: Sol subdues the Sector administrator without much effort. Surprisingly enough, it does not put up much resistance.

units.rawText: Will this do?
units.displayText: Will this do?

spans.text: Will this do?

units.rawText: Hang on, I can almost see its AI...
units.displayText: Hang on, I can almost see its AI...

spans.text: Hang on, I can almost see its AI...

units.rawText: I see, it's just as I thought. The Sector Administrator's neural core is extremely simple. It only has two preset commands.
units.displayText: I see, it's just as I thought. The Sector Administrator's neural core is extremely simple. It only has two preset commands.

spans.text: I see, it's just as I thought. The Sector Administrator's neural core is extremely simple. It only has two preset commands.

units.rawText: One is to send feedback to Svarog Heavy Industries in a timely manner. Due to the disconnection, this function is now banned.
units.displayText: One is to send feedback to Svarog Heavy Industries in a timely manner. Due to the disconnection, this function is now banned.

spans.text: One is to send feedback to Svarog Heavy Industries in a timely manner. Due to the disconnection, this function is now banned.

units.rawText: The other is to log and control the direction of the experiment, so as to prevent the sector from continuing the same approaches after a reset and thus wasting resources.
units.displayText: The other is to log and control the direction of the experiment, so as to prevent the sector from continuing the same approaches after a reset and thus wasting resources.

spans.text: The other is to log and control the direction of the experiment, so as to prevent the sector from continuing the same approaches after a reset and thus wasting resources.

units.rawText: So, how do we leave? Is there a way we can do that?
units.displayText: So, how do we leave? Is there a way we can do that?

spans.text: So, how do we leave? Is there a way we can do that?

units.rawText: Persicaria's face turns pale.
units.displayText: Persicaria's face turns pale.

spans.text: Persicaria's face turns pale.

units.rawText: No. This administrator has no other control directives.
units.displayText: No. This administrator has no other control directives.

spans.text: No. This administrator has no other control directives.

units.rawText: It doesn't even have the ability to stop the resets.
units.displayText: It doesn't even have the ability to stop the resets.

spans.text: It doesn't even have the ability to stop the resets.

units.rawText: What?! But how?! Are we going to be stuck here forever?!
units.displayText: What?! But how?! Are we going to be stuck here forever?!

spans.text: What?! But how?! Are we going to be stuck here forever?!

units.rawText: Sol's unconscious shout pricks the bubble of unease and fear swelling in our hearts.
units.displayText: Sol's unconscious shout pricks the bubble of unease and fear swelling in our hearts.

spans.text: Sol's unconscious shout pricks the bubble of unease and fear swelling in our hearts.

units.rawText: After a long silence, Croque exhales a deep breath and pats Sol on the shoulder.
units.displayText: After a long silence, Croque exhales a deep breath and pats Sol on the shoulder.

spans.text: After a long silence, Croque exhales a deep breath and pats Sol on the shoulder.

units.rawText: It'll be fine, Sol. No need to worry.
units.displayText: It'll be fine, Sol. No need to worry.

spans.text: It'll be fine, Sol. No need to worry.

units.rawText: The administrator said so just now, right? Once the Arche Pyr Project is complete, we can leave.
units.displayText: The administrator said so just now, right? Once the Arche Pyr Project is complete, we can leave.

spans.text: The administrator said so just now, right? Once the Arche Pyr Project is complete, we can leave.

units.rawText: Relax. I'm a mechanical expert. There's bound to be a way to solve this.
units.displayText: Relax. I'm a mechanical expert. There's bound to be a way to solve this.

spans.text: Relax. I'm a mechanical expert. There's bound to be a way to solve this.

units.rawText: Croque's confident words briefly lighten the mood in the air, but before Sol can reply with anything more than some light-hearted banter, what Persicaria says next is like a bucket of ice water over all of us.
units.displayText: Croque's confident words briefly lighten the mood in the air, but before Sol can reply with anything more than some light-hearted banter, what Persicaria says next is like a bucket of ice water over all of us.

spans.text: Croque's confident words briefly lighten the mood in the air, but before Sol can reply with anything more than some light-hearted banter, what Persicaria says next is like a bucket of ice water over all of us.

units.rawText: We might not have the time to do that...
units.displayText: We might not have the time to do that...

spans.text: We might not have the time to do that...

units.rawText: Do you remember hearing that announcement after eating Choco's chocolate, while a reset was taking place?
units.displayText: Do you remember hearing that announcement after eating Choco's chocolate, while a reset was taking place?

spans.text: Do you remember hearing that announcement after eating Choco's chocolate, while a reset was taking place?

units.rawText: You mean, Serial No. 99800 or something, commencing rectification, something like that?
units.displayText: You mean, Serial No. 99800 or something, commencing rectification, something like that?

spans.text: You mean, Serial No. 99800 or something, commencing rectification, something like that?

units.rawText: What about it?
units.displayText: What about it?

spans.text: What about it?

units.rawText: In order to prevent extraneous data from accumulating and causing data overflow, the Helios Sector reset function has a data deletion function as well.
units.displayText: In order to prevent extraneous data from accumulating and causing data overflow, the Helios Sector reset function has a data deletion function as well.

spans.text: In order to prevent extraneous data from accumulating and causing data overflow, the Helios Sector reset function has a data deletion function as well.

units.rawText: It will completely reset Helios Sector to its base state, and the trigger for that is 100,000 resets.
units.displayText: It will completely reset Helios Sector to its base state, and the trigger for that is 100,000 resets.

spans.text: It will completely reset Helios Sector to its base state, and the trigger for that is 100,000 resets.

units.rawText: And currently, we're on reset number 99860.
units.displayText: And currently, we're on reset number 99860.

spans.text: And currently, we're on reset number 99860.

units.rawText: ...Which means we only have 140 resets left.
units.displayText: ...Which means we only have 140 resets left.

spans.text: ...Which means we only have 140 resets left.

units.rawText: The sudden bad news throws us for a loop.
units.displayText: The sudden bad news throws us for a loop.

spans.text: The sudden bad news throws us for a loop.

units.rawText: For once, Persicaria is completely out of ideas. She looks blankly at me, hoping that I can give an order.
units.displayText: For once, Persicaria is completely out of ideas. She looks blankly at me, hoping that I can give an order.

spans.text: For once, Persicaria is completely out of ideas. She looks blankly at me, hoping that I can give an order.

units.rawText: Prepare for the next explosion.
units.displayText: Prepare for the next explosion.

spans.text: Prepare for the next explosion.

units.rawText: The explosion's coming... Wait, that statue!
units.displayText: The explosion's coming... Wait, that statue!

spans.text: The explosion's coming... Wait, that statue!

units.rawText: A swelling roar fills the air and the ground suddenly shakes. A moment before the explosion, the statue beside the administrator suddenly turns its head.
units.displayText: A swelling roar fills the air and the ground suddenly shakes. A moment before the explosion, the statue beside the administrator suddenly turns its head.

spans.text: A swelling roar fills the air and the ground suddenly shakes. A moment before the explosion, the statue beside the administrator suddenly turns its head.

units.rawText: ...And looks straight at us.
units.displayText: ...And looks straight at us.

spans.text: ...And looks straight at us.

units.rawText: In that moment, everything within sight suddenly vanishes, and the sound in my ears becomes a monotonous ringing.
units.displayText: In that moment, everything within sight suddenly vanishes, and the sound in my ears becomes a monotonous ringing.

spans.text: In that moment, everything within sight suddenly vanishes, and the sound in my ears becomes a monotonous ringing.

units.rawText: Sequence Number 99861, commencing rectification.
units.displayText: Sequence Number 99861, commencing rectification.

spans.text: Sequence Number 99861, commencing rectification.

units.rawText: Also, why are there so many weird statues along the sides of this path...
units.displayText: Also, why are there so many weird statues along the sides of this path...
